reason: I have 20 clients, and five groups dumped into one sheet means juggling four Google accounts and splitting the data back out by hand before I can resell it as a service. With no Jurnal or Accurate export I still retype everything, so I'd try the 40 free documents and stop there.
objection: It isn't built for a firm. I need each client in its own sheet under one login, and an export into Jurnal/Accurate, or there's nothing I can mark up and sell to my clients.
would_change_my_mind: A firm or reseller plan: unlimited client groups under one account, a separate sheet per client, and a direct Jurnal/Accurate import file, priced so I can keep a margin.
